title: Binarization of a gate
statement: Given an input count $n$, a gate $g$, and an existing gate list $g_s$, if $g$ is a NOT gate, append it unchanged and return vertex $n+|g_s|$. For an AND or OR gate, recursively emit a tree of that kind on the distinct arguments of $g$, starting from $g_s$.
